name: Proxima Midnight

abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Safeguard: Vurulurken veya bloklarken herhangi bir kaynaktan alınabilecek can kaybını belirli bir yüzdeyle sınırlar.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Proxima Midnight için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Cosmic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Ultimate Mission
Reach 100 hits on the Combo Meter. When this mission is complete, she gains a Fury Buff for every mission completed at that time, each increasing her Attack Rating by [839.08 - 2,328.48] for the rest of the fight.
When completing this mission, Proxima Midnight activates a permanent passive True Accuracy effect.

abilitySections.title: Missions From Thanos
content: Proxima Midnight has 3 missions to accomplish, one at a time, in random order.
Mission 2: Intercept Attack: Perform 4 intercepts against a dashing opponent.
Mission 3: Incapacitate: Knockdown the opponent 5 times using a Heavy or Special Attack.
When Proxima completes an objective on one of her missions, she gains passive True Accuracy for 5 seconds.

Whenever completing a mission, she gains a Prowess Buff, increasing Special Damage by 250% per mission completed for 10 seconds. When the temporary Prowess Buff expires, Proxima receives her next mission and gains permanent Prowess, enhancing Special Damage by 200% for the rest of the fight.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: If Proxima has more than 30 hits in her Combo Meter, she can activate a Safeguard Buff when attacked by a projectile, preventing her from losing more than 3% of her max Health from a single source for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: Opponents have 200% Offensive Ability Accuracy reduction when Proxima Midnight Blocks an Attack. Additionally, she can use the Parry Mastery against any Basic Attack, stunning opponents even if their attack is non-contact.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: +[7,276.5] Attack Rating if the opponent has an active Regeneration Buff or Passive.
Inflicts Heal Block, preventing the target from recovering Health for 7 seconds. If Proxima has more than 50 hits in her Combo Meter, the duration of this Heal Block is doubled.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [2,250] for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Ultimate Mission
content: Reach 100 hits on the Combo Meter. When this mission is complete, she gains a Fury Buff for every mission completed at that time, each increasing her Attack Rating by [839.08 - 2,328.48] for the rest of the fight.
When completing this mission, Proxima Midnight activates a permanent passive True Accuracy effect.
